title: Build Anything Hackathon
summary: Build a project using the UnoRouter API, submit a GitHub repository and include a working demo. Free online hackathon in the CircuitFeed Build Series.
eligibility: Participants aged 18 or older from India. Solo developers and teams may enter; each team member must register individually.

prize.description: UnoRouter credits: first $100, second $50, third $25. Eligible submissions receive participation certificates; special certificates for the top three teams.

notes: Registration and submission deadline: 12 December 2026; exact cutoff time not supplied.
